For Applicant : Mr. Shobhit Koshta, Advocate For Respondent/State : Ms. Sunita Jain, G.A. Hon'ble
Shri Justice Parth Prateem Sahu Order On Board 18/10/2023
1.

Applicant has filed this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 for grant of regular bail as he has been arrested in connection with Crime No.51/2021,
registered at Police Station - Chhuriya, District - Rajnandgaon (C.G.) for offence punishable under Section 363, 366, 376 (2) (n) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4, 6 of POCSO Act.
2.
This is second bail application of applicant for grant of regular bail.

His earlier bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 24.11.2021 in M.Cr.C. No.8113 of 2021 with liberty to revive the same after examination of the prosecutrix before the trial Court.
3. Learned counsel for applicant submits that applicant has been falsely implicated in this case.
He has not committed any office.
He is in jail since 14.08.2021.
Victim has now been examined before the learned trial Court and she has not supported the case of the prosecution.

He also contended that he has placed copy of deposition sheet on record of father of victim, victim and mother of victim, who were examined before the learned trial Court as P.W.-3, P.W.-4 and P.W.-6 respectively.
4. Learned counsel for State opposes the submission of learned counsel for applicant.
5. Victim is present before this Court through virtual mode and submits that she has no objection in grant of bail to the applicant.

sentences.text: I have heard learned counsel for the parties.

7. Considering the submission of learned counsel for respective parties as also the deposition sheet placed no record of victim and her parents without commenting anything on merits of the case, I am inclined to allow the bail application.
8. Accordingly, the bail application filed under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on regular bail upon his furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety in the like sum to the satisfaction of the Court on the conditions that:-
a). Applicant shall appear before the trial Court regularly on each and every date,
unless exempted from appearance.
(b). Applicant shall not, in any manner, tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
c). If the applicant is found involved in similar offence in the future, it will be open for the State to apply for cancellation of Bail.
Certified copy as per rules.
